data.description: Ideal Home and Investment | Prime Palm Address | High Rental Demand
data.long_description:
Experience refined beachfront living in this elegant 1-bedroom apartment at Palm Central Private Residences, ideally located on the iconic Palm Jumeirah. Designed for comfort and modern luxury, this spacious home offers a seamless blend of style, functionality, and resort-style living.

Property Features:
- Spacious 1 Bedroom Apartment 
- 843.13Sqft. Total Area
- Modern open-plan layout
- High-quality finishes throughout 
- Floor-to-ceiling windows
- Built-in wardrobes
- Contemporary kitchen

Building & Community Amenities:
- Private beach access
- Infinity swimming pool
- Fully equipped gymnasium
- 24/7 security & concierge services
- Dedicated parking
- Exclusive residents facilities

The apartment features a bright open-plan living and dining area, complemented by floor-to-ceiling windows that allow natural light to flood the space. The contemporary kitchen is thoughtfully designed with high-quality finishes and ample storage, making it perfect for both everyday living and entertaining.
